name: safari-carousel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  safari-carousel.scss — Safari-only carousel overrides injected into the
//  carousel shadow root by safari-patch.js: removes GPU-promotion hints that
//  cause iOS compositing artifacts.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

// Chrome uses will-change/transform on the carousel for the fade-in; on iOS
// that promotion creates a persistent compositor layer that flickers during
// scroll — so these overrides strip it and let the slide just appear.
.carousel {
  will-change: auto;
  transform: none;

  &.carousel--in-view {
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}

// Native scroll, no smooth-scroll interpolation (JS drives the snapping).
.carousel-track {
  scroll-behavior: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

// Slides size to their media's natural (cap-clamped) height so mixed-width
// items keep their own aspect; contain isolates each slide so a layout shift
// in one doesn't reflow the whole track.
.carousel-slide {
  height: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  contain: layout paint;
}

.internal-extra-item {
  width: auto;
  height: 100%;
}

media-figure {
  height: 100%;
  width: auto;
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
